home.text: At Kingdom Life Christian Church, church is more than a place—it’s a family. We’re a welcoming community where everyone can find connection, belonging, and encouragement as they grow in faith together. Through inspiring sermons, meaningful small groups, and practical classes, we’re passionate about helping people build authentic relationships, discover their God-given purpose, and live it out with confidence. Whether this is your first time in church, or your first time in a while, we invite you to be our guest—or make us your church for life!
Join us for church, Sundays at 10 AM EST.

easter.text: KINGDOM LIFE CHRISTIAN CHURCH 1455 Naugatuck Avenue Milford, CT 06461 ► DIRECTIONS ► WHAT TO EXPECT ONLINE ► SUNDAYS AT 10 AM ► VIA OUR APP

Our doors open at 9:45 AM on Sunday. After you're greeted by our welcoming Hospitality Team, you can make your way to your seats guided by our Usher Team. Can I bring my kids? Of course! We offer programming designed specifically for children from 6 weeks old thru 6th grade. How long is the Easter service? Our Easter service is approximately 75 minutes long. Will I be singled out in any way? Not at all. As our guest, we want you to feel comfortable and invite you to engage with the service however you choose. We offer a variety of ways to interact within the service, singing, greeting one another, giving, but please do not feel obligated to participate if any of those make you feel uncomfortable. We’d love to meet you. Following the close of service, we invite you to stop in the lobby at either of our Guest Reception areas so we can meet you in person and give you a special gift. Have a question that wasn’t answered? Our team will be happy to help answer your questions. Click here to CONTACT US .

new.text: Welcome
New Here
We're so glad you are here! Whether you are new to this church or new to faith, welcome!

Kingdom Life Christian Church is a Christ-centered, Bible-believing, Spirit-filled church which is founded on the belief that God’s Kingdom must be demonstrated “on earth as it is in heaven.” Our congregation draws together people of all races, gender, economic levels, ages, and religious backgrounds. Through Bible-centered preaching and teaching, prayer, practical ministry, and genuine relationships, KLCC encourages and empowers people for the challenges of life. We invite you to join us for a service, a season, or a lifetime.
I'M New
Tell us what you'd like to know more about our church.
I have Decided
If you're a new believer or newly rededicated, congratulations on your decision to follow Jesus! We'd love to help you grow as a Christ follower.
the Next Step
Water baptism is the next step in your spiritual journey. If you have made the decision to follow Jesus Christ, we encourage you to be baptized.
Plan a Visit

We want to be sure your first time visit is a great experience! We would love to help as much or as little as you’d like, from navigating parking to checking out the campus, or even just introducing your family to some great members of our congregation. We understand that visiting a new church can feel overwhelming, so we’re happy to help lighten the process in a way that’s most comfortable for you.
What to Expect

If you're new here, we can’t wait to meet you! We know your time is valuable and we appreciate you using it to worship with us. At Kingdom Life you'll find a diverse community of people with different stories and unique perspectives, all sharing the common truth that we are saved by Jesus Christ. Whether you wear a suit or dress, jeans or shorts, come as you are to experience Jesus with a community who proclaims and demonstrates His love.
Arriving at the Cathedral

Upon entering our parking lot we ask that you have your hazard lights on so our parking team can identify you and guide you to our reserved parking section. Once you've parked your vehicle make your way to our main entrance. There our greeters will welcome you and provide you with any information you may need for service. If you have any questions, feel free to ask and they will point you in the right direction.
Do you have Children?

Children are invited to our Kingdom Kids service! With classes ranging from 6 weeks old to 6th grade, we use interactive media, small groups, and hands-on activities to create a fun, safe environment where they learn that Jesus loves them, and they are valued with an individual and specific purpose! In our Cathedral lobby on the upper level, you can register your child(ren) at the Check-In Hub. Here we securely check in each child to provide you with peace of mind while you enjoy service. Classrooms open 15 minutes before service begins. Once the rooms are open you may drop off your child(ren) with any of our trained volunteers, all of whom have passed background checks.
Find Your Seat

As you enter the sanctuary our usher team will be happy to guide you to a seat. As our guest we want you to feel comfortable and invite you to engage with the service however you choose. A typical Sunday morning will consist of singing, greeting one another, and giving. Shortly thereafter a Christ-centered, relevant, practical message will be shared to encourage and challenge you for the week to come.
Before You Leave

Please don’t feel that you need to rush out after service—we can’t wait to greet you face to face in our Guest Center located on the right side of our lobby as you are leaving the building. Even if small talk isn’t your thing, just stop by for the free gift. Hope to meet you soon!
How can we pray for you?

We would be honored to pray for you or for someone you know. As believers, we are all called to be intercessors. If you are part of a Life Group, we encourage you to also share your prayer request with your group.
Request Pastoral Advising

Most people find pastoral advising very helpful; however, depending on the nature of your difficulty, you might also experience uncomfortable emotions such as anger, fear, and frustration during the course of counseling. While a pastoral advisor cannot remove these feelings from you, they will help you work through them, or seek an alternative counselor. Scheduling is subject to pastoral availability.

our-story.text: It takes a special kind of person to build without resources, see the unseen, and believe for the impossible. It takes a special kind of person to walk humbly, to love unconditionally, and to live with integrity. It takes the crafting and calling of God to have one person possess all of these traits. Blending savvy wisdom with personal discipline, Bishop has brought Kingdom Life from a God-given dream to the place we know it to be today. A life-long learner, Bishop has proven his words and insight to be relevant, trustworthy, and timely. Speaking from a place of revelation and from a higher, more big-picture perspective, he reminds us all that it is God’s solutions we seek, and God’s alone. By his side, with grace, strength, and passion, Jeannine has exemplified what it means to stand firm and protect the vision God placed in the heart of her husband, for their family, and this church for 30 years, all while making time to bless so many of us in the process. A true leading lady, Jeannine has proven it is possible, even in this current culture, to truly walk as a woman of grace and beauty.

In 1991, Bishop Jay Ramirez, along with about 40 people, founded Kingdom Life Christian Church. The mission was clear, to proclaim and demonstrate the gospel of the Kingdom and the rule of Christ as God’s solution to the kingdoms of this world. The vision was colossal, to be an intergenerational, intercultural church. A community that would teach and train practical biblical principles, preparing the next generations to discover and live through their God-given identity and purpose. A church that would break down cultural walls, welcoming all who would choose to join us, restoring the hurt and broken, and serving our community with humility and compassion. A resource to the local and global Body of Christ by collaborating with other ministries and churches.

Anchored by the core principles of faith, hard work, and character that were instilled into him as a child, Bishop would go on to lead Kingdom Life as Senior Pastor for 30 years. Through his leadership, wisdom, and discipline Kingdom Life has been able to go where we could only imagine and become what we couldn’t have even dreamed of. Kingdom Life has served thousands and hundreds of thousands near and far, from working with local political leaders to overseeing a global network of churches, we strive to proclaim and demonstrate the good news of the Gospel to the individual and their respective communities.

Having served the community for more than three decades, Kingdom Life has had the privilege of experiencing the growth into who we are currently, and the vision to mature into who we are purposed to be.

Driven by a heart for God’s future, we are training and empowering a new generation of dynamic, younger leadership. Our mission remains simple and unwavering: this house belongs to Jesus, and His is the only voice we truly follow.

leadership.text: Our leadership is a team comprised of ordained pastors who are responsible for the care, the guiding, and the leading of our Kingdom Life community.
Bishop Jay and Jeannine Ramirez are the founding pastors of Kingdom Life Christian Church, also overseeing other churches and ministries in the US and in other countries.

Since the founding of KLCC in 1991 to the present, both serve as the senior elders of the KLCC ministry leadership. They offer guidance, accountability, and counsel to the lead pastor, and to the ministry staff, as well as speak periodically from either the pulpit, in department gatherings, or in private leadership meetings. Together they both oversee and manage many of the major administrative functions of the ministry. This includes property management, accounting and investments, employee administration, legal issues, insurance, equipment and vehicle purchases, and other areas. Traveling frequently as a primary outreach ministry of Kingdom Life, Bishop and Jeannine have spoken at events, consult ministry leaders, secular business leaders, and companies. All carried out with the Kingdom mandate to bring salt and light to the unchurched world, as well as to the people of God. Bishop and Jeannine have two daughters, Danielle and Tiffany, one son-in-law, Pastor TJ Niglio, and a granddaughter, Antonella.

that is under your care, watching over them—not because you must but because you are willing, as God wants you to be; not pursuing dishonest gain but eager to serve; not lording it over those entrusted to you but being examples to the flock. // 1st Peter 5:2-3

With a passion for truth, Pastor TJ is an example of what Jesus told us when He commissioned us to go into all the world and make disciples. Brilliantly he has used his character and discipline to lead both in our church and on the job. Since licensed in 2018 and ordained in 2023, Pastor TJ was set apart for ministry, blending facts and figures with faith, introducing the Gospel through logic and reason. He never backs down from the tough questions and keeps a compassionate heart toward the hearer.

From his first introduction to Kingdom Life, to the unbelievable way he merged the church he was pastoring and joined with us, to leading an area of ministry that has been a personal passion well before the opportunity presented itself, there have been many roads that Pastor Manny has traveled and we're glad they all lead him here. Licensed in 2005 and ordained in 2023, he serves as the man behind the scenes for all our productions. If you've streamed a service live, listened to our podcast, or marveled at the lights, camera, and action in person, it's Pastor Manny and his team that make what you see come to life.

Since joining Kingdom Life as a teenager, Pastor Jason has been an integral part of our praise and worship team. Whether arranging sets or writing original music, he and his team have been consistent in providing an environment where all people can experience the presence of God. From his licensing in 2015 and ordination in 2023, we've had the pleasure of watching Pastor Jason's preaching gift grow. Inspired by personal experiences and rooted in Scripture, he uses a conversational style to challenge and provoke all hearers to discover the Holy Spirit for themselves and the evidence of His fruit.

Only a handful of people have been part of our ministry since its beginning 35 years ago; fewer still who have journeyed from being a teen and now raising their teens within this very ministry—Pastor Sandy is one of those rare few. Licensed in 2018 and ordained in 2023, Pastor Sandy brings a vibrant passion for worship and youth discipleship. Making the Scripture accessible and relevant, she is committed to using every creative avenue to equip teens with biblical truth—offering support and guidance, always leading with grace and love.

Leading from the heart of a servant, Pastor Brandon has been a constant for years with our children, youth, and young adults. Today he leads a vibrant prayer ministry, disciples those newest to the faith, and connecting and enriching our church family to create friendship and belonging. Since his licensing in 2018 and ordination in 2023, Pastor Brandon has continued to grow, teaching with humor and cultural relevance to meet the hearers where they are, and bringing truth whenever the opportunity presents itself.

Believing that a strong faith begins at home, Pastor Lori's mission is dedicated to empowering families and training volunteers to raise children who are ready to thrive in the world ahead of them. Ordained with Kingdom Life in 2026, Pastor Lori blends logic, reason, and a deep love for the Word to provide a safe space for kids to dream big, discover their purpose, and grow in character. Together with her team, she is shaping a generation of courageous disciples to lead with compassion and a firm foundation in Christ.

beliefs.text: ...The Bible is the inspired Word of God which was given to us for instruction, correction and inspiration. ...In one God manifested in the Persons of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. ...Man was created in the image of God, and because of man’s disobedience in the garden we are all born with a sin nature. ...Jesus Christ is the Son of God, was conceived by the Holy Spirit through the Virgin Mary, and born to deliver us from our fallen sin nature. ...Jesus died on the Cross, rose from the dead, and is alive today, and as a result, eternal life is ours, as we believe and confess Jesus as Savior and Lord. ...Through Christ, God sent His Holy Spirit. Through His Holy Spirit, we become the Body of Christ on the earth, empowered to demonstrate the nature and the power of God. ...All believers are called to be ministers of the Gospel and ambassadors of the Kingdom. To accomplish that calling God has given us gifts of insight, gifts of service, and gifts of power. ...God’s Kingdom is real and eternal, superseding all other kingdoms of this world. The mission of the church is to proclaim and demonstrate the Gospel of the Kingdom and the Rule of Christ as God’s solution to the kingdoms of this world. ...In the return of Christ. He came in Person; He sent His Spirit; He will one day return for an obedient Bride, the Church. Regardless of when or how He comes, we shall be with Him and like Him forever.

pastoral-care.text: We are a church-based ministry providing pastoral and scriptural advising. We offer spiritual guidance to individuals who may be struggling with a variety of challenges. Our hope is that your faith and trust in God’s healing power for restoration would grow and strengthen you in your situation.

Most people find pastoral advising very helpful; however, depending on the nature of your difficulty, you might also experience uncomfortable emotions such as anger, fear, and frustration during the course of counseling. While a pastoral advisor cannot remove these feelings from you, they will help you work through them, or seek an alternative counselor. Scheduling is subject to pastoral availability.

life-groups.text: Life Groups meet in 12-week trimesters throughout the year where we can engage with one another, build intentional connections, and create friendships and belonging. Groups meet at varying times and in varying demographics, from general (open to anyone) to more specific, like new parents. Whatever your age or stage of life, there is a place for you. To better serve you, we meet using a hybrid model where some groups meet online while others may meet in person.
Find a Group that Best Fits Your Life and Schedule:
For young and old, single or married, in college or a parent, any age and stage of life is welcome in our General groups.
A women-only group where ladies of any age and stage of life are invited to enjoy sisterhood camaraderie.
Become stronger men. Focus on the betterment as individuals, and as the spiritual head of your families and marriages.
For young adults ages 18-25 to grow and connect with others of similar age and stage of life.
New to parenthood? Connect with like-minded, first-time parents, glean from valuable insights, and build community during your early years of parenting.
If you’re just beginning your Christian walk or want a refresher in what you believe, this group is for you.

Alpha sessions are a connection and conversation spanning the course of 12 weeks that explore those questions and more in a welcoming, judgement free environment. Alpha meets Wednesdays at 7 PM at the Cathedral, with virtual classes available on alternative evenings.

courses.text: Wednesday Nights at KLCC are for Discipleship!

Looking for Bible-centered classes to help you grow in your faith and apply God's wisdom to everyday life? Our Wednesday night discipleship courses are a place to learn, connect, and grow in your walk with God. Go deeper. Grow stronger. Take your next step.

Alpha is a place to explore life's big questions: What is my purpose? What happens when I die? Why is there suffering? Over 12 weeks, people come together to share throughs, hear different perspectives, and have honest conversations in a judgment-free environment.

Why believe in God? Can the Bible be trusted? What do we do with questions about suffering? This course explores some of the biggest questions about Christianity and helps you build confidence in what you believe and why.

Want to share your faith but not sure where to start? This course will help you grow in confidence and learn how to have natural, authentic gospel conversations through biblical teaching, real-life stories, and practical exercises.

Take control of your money and achieve financial peace with Financial Peace University (FPU). This 9-week course based on biblical principles provides a step-by-step plan to get out of debt, save for the future, and build wealth while offering a supportive community for accountability and lasting change.

How to Study the Bible is an 8-week, hands-on course that helps you understand and apply Scripture in daily life. You’ll learn how to observe, interpret, and live out God’s Word through engaging videos, group discussions, and weekly homework. Whether you're just starting or want to grow deeper, this class will build your confidence in studying the Bible.

Explore the meaning and power of the Lord’s Prayer in this 8-week course. Through engaging discussion and uplifting teaching, you’ll grow closer to God and strengthen your faith. Whether you're just starting out or looking to go deeper, discover how this timeless prayer can guide your daily life.

This course is for parents with children up to middle school age. Find peace in the middle of everyday chaos. Learn simple daily habits and easy-to-implement routines that help you create a home where your whole family can grow closer to God and each other.

The Marriage Course is a 7-session series designed to help couples strengthen their relationship—whether you've been married for months or decades, and whether things are going well or you're facing challenges. You'll learn practical skills like better communication, resolving conflict, understanding each other’s needs, and building deeper intimacy.

God is generous and so He calls us to be as well. What we do with what He has given us shows the community and the world around us where our hearts are at and helps proclaim the gospel. We want to glorify God with every area of our lives, including what we do with our finances. Whether you have much or little to give, we welcome you to join us. Together we can make a difference.

True Christianity is about living to give. True giving includes our time, talents, gifts and prayers. But it also includes our finances. The Bible teaches that the first portion, or tithe (10%), belongs to God. The commitment to give should be made in obedience to God and with a cheerful heart. God honors that which is offered freely with joy and expectation and not grudgingly, or out of guilt or obligation. While God’s promises say that we will reap a blessing when we give, our motivation is not for receiving but to show God a demonstration of our love and trust.
